name: Ethiopia (1897–1914)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, yellow and green, with the red Amharic letter 'ም' on the yellow stripe.
history: On 11 October 1897, a year after the victory at Adwa, Emperor Menelik II ordered the three traditional pennants combined into a rectangular tricolour of red, yellow and green, from top to bottom, with the first letter of his name on the central stripe. After his death the order of the stripes was reversed in 1914 to green, yellow and red and the Lion of Judah replaced the letter.

features.role: Amharic letter ም, initial of Menelik
